preconditions.description: The length of the input string must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'MF' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string must consist only of the characters 'M' and 'F'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if 'M' not in stdin or 'F' not in stdin else True
postconditions.description: If the input string contains only boys or only girls, the output must be 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(seconds) where seconds is the number of seconds needed to move all girls in front of boys
postconditions.description: The output must be the number of seconds required to rearrange the line such that all girls are in front of all boys.
